caption: San Giovanni in Laterano, Rome
composition: Galilei facade with attic statues and Lateran Obelisk on the piazza · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The viewpoint is from the piazza at midday, facing the full breadth of the Galilei facade. The colossal columns and the row of attic statues, with the enthroned Christ at the center, stretch across the frame, the Lateran Obelisk rising at the far left and a bell tower at the far right. The modelled 23 September 2026, 11:50 light is strong and even under a clear blue sky, the white travertine glowing against the dark paving of the square.
